# Brainstorming Skill

Supports the `/cg-brainstorm` prompt with structured workflows for requirement elicitation and decision capture.

## When to Use

- Requirements are fuzzy or incomplete
- Multiple approaches are possible and you need to decide
- A new project or feature needs scoping
- You want to document architectural decisions
